body:
tool_tests.jl builds an Optimizer using JLD2.

This is the easiest fix to unblock other people's work, but probably not a good long term solution.

I also preemptively added compat bounds to the docs and buildkite project tomls, which would start failing the next time the manifests are updated.


The neural snow extension was written to support generic models. Because of this, it saves and loads the full structure of each network, including internal structs of downstream packages. The last Optimisers.jl patch release changes the fields of an internal struct. 

## Long term options

- Delete the support for generic models. Build the model in ext code (possibly parameterized with a toml), and only store/read weights. 

- Re-generate the artifacts every time a dependency changes an internal struct in a breaking way
- We could add this as a weak dep, but that seems like it is kicking the can down the road. I'm guessing this test will break again in the future because it is quite reliant on downstream and base Julia internals.
